name: solarcards
description: Four Home Assistant Lovelace cards for solar setups: solar generation as a bar chart with forecast (PV Energy Diagram), energy flow (PV/battery/grid) as a ring/Sankey diagram (PV Energy Flow Card), battery state of charge with a charge-time forecast (PV Battery Card), and payback progress with a savings-over-time chart (PV Payback Card) — all with optional cost display.
